capabilities: Sync the vault two-way to a hosted Git memory
Expose the memory to AI clients over MCP
Choose or create a sync target memory
Flag unmergeable edit conflicts in a conflicts note
Show sync status from the status bar and command palette
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not device-to-device vault sync; it syncs to a hosted AI-accessible memory rather than between your own devices.
extras: The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it is desktop only with mobile planned, and includes up to 100 MB of EU-hosted storage per account.
problem: Obsidian notes are not reachable by AI assistants, so users must manually copy note content into each chat or tool.

relations.evidence: the same memory is exposed at memory.agentage.io, so Claude / ChatGPT / Cursor read and write the same notes

summary: Two-way Git sync that mirrors the vault to a hosted memory exposed over MCP, so AI clients like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor can read and write notes.
